subject: R-INLA Crash After C++ Runtime Library Message - INLA SPDE Survival Analysis

messages.author: a259015b36a46546
messages.subject: R-INLA Crash After C++ Runtime Library Message - INLA SPDE Survival Analysis
parts:
Hi

I revisited an old work. The last time I worked on the data was in August 2022 and all the models run without an issue. However, I noticed today there is a windows message (Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime Library) that appear while running my models then once I click any option INLA crashes shortly afterwards with the verbose output below. A simpler version of the same model with limited covariates runs fine. Please find the necessary details below. Any help on addressing this new challenges would be greatly appreciated. 

NB: Due to the sensitive nature of the data, I am doing my analysis via an institution platform hence have limited options such as updating R-INLA to the latest testing version etc. 

##This works
form_a <-  inla.surv(time, cens) ~ -1 + Intercept + Region + f(s4, model=spde4)

## This gives the error below
form_b <-  inla.surv(time, cens) ~ -1 + Intercept + Age + sex + imm + edu + socio + wlth + P_DEN + P_AGE + P_SEX + P_IMM + P_EDU + P_WLTH + P_EMP + Region + f(s4,model=spde4)
